cues.speaker: TV
cues.en: With twelve hours until the Kyoto Summit,

cues.speaker: TV
cues.en: delegates from around the world are arriving in Kyoto.

cues.speaker: TV
cues.en: Recent polls at home and abroad show growing support

cues.speaker: TV
cues.en: for a complete quarantine of Neo Kobe,

cues.speaker: TV
cues.en: apparently driven by fears of Snatcher infiltration.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Now that the chief's death is confirmed,

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: JUNKER will soon lose its authority.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: The summit will decide Neo Kobe's fate in twelve hours.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: They say a nuclear bomb will wipe out the city and its Snatchers.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Insane! In the 21st century?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: It's not just a rumor. Every country fears the spread of Snatchers.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: The chief was going to the summit to stop that.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: But now there's no hope.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: The government began pressuring JUNKER several months ago.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Your transfer to JUNKER was our last chance, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Now that even the chief was snatched,

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: they have even less reason to trust JUNKER.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: The military and FBI will apparently take over.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Yes. That will also be decided in twelve hours.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Twelve hours to find their hideout.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Or we're dead, along with everyone in the city.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: To them, this city's a tumor. Cut it out and sink it.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: We have to strike the Snatchers' base before that.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Can you do it, Gillian?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: If we can find their hideout.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Attacking places like Queen Hospital won't help.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: We have to hit their main base.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: What about the chief Snatcher's memory?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Completely erased, as before. A form of self-destruction.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Metal! What about tracing Jamie's videophone call?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: There wasn't enough time.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: But it definitely came from somewhere in this city.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Damn it! Where? Where are they?

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Can't you remember anything, Gillian?

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Did Jamie say anything about a connection to the Snatchers?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I can't remember a thing.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Metal, tell me everything you know about who I am!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Why was I sent to JUNKER? Where did I come from?

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Gillian...

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: The chief's gone! Tell me what you know, Metal!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Well, you see...

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Metal!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Understood. With the chief dead, you're in command now.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: You knew?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Of course.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Where were we rescued?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: You and Jamie were rescued three years ago,

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: on September 25, 2039, from the Siberian neutral zone

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: by the seventeenth Siberian expedition.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: To be precise, you were found in cryogenic pods

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: in an underground shelter near Moscow.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Cryogenic sleep? Artificial hibernation?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: This photo was taken at the time.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: We don't know how long you'd been asleep there.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: A third, empty pod was found with you.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Three pods?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: You were revived and placed under military protection.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: You had both lost all your memories,

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: perhaps from prolonged cryogenic sleep.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Or perhaps they'd been erased.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: This was your only possession when you were rescued.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Isn't that a picture of Harry as a child?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Yes. Harry is your son, yours and Jamie's. DNA tests confirmed it.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: The old man was my son?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Using the photo's data,

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: we identified you as Gillian Seed and Jamie Lorraine.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Both American citizens, born in the 1970s.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: The 1970s?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: You both disappeared in 1985.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: There are no records of you after that.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Yes. You come from the world of fifty years ago.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: But what does that have to do with the Snatchers?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Well, the expedition

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: that rescued you had an accident on the way back.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: You both survived, but most of the team died.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: There was a Snatcher among them.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: They'd all been thoroughly examined before departure.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: So if they were snatched...

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Somewhere in Siberia.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Yes.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: The government sent you both to JUNKER

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: to learn your identities and uncover the truth about Snatchers.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: They hoped contact with Snatchers would restore your memories.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Moscow, fifty years ago.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Almost everyone who knew Moscow then died in the outbreak.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: So you two are the only living witnesses.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: The old man. Harry was our son.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Did he know?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: No. It was top secret. He was told nothing.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: My God. I couldn't do anything for him.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Wait, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Didn't Jamie say they were holding her child hostage?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: That's it! They're using Harry to threaten Jamie.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: We must find their hideout, fast!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: We have twelve hours.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Let's review what we know, Gillian. We might find a clue.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Right. Their behavior might tell us something.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Let's go over what we've learned about the Snatchers.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: First, what is their weakness?

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: It may be a kind of homing instinct.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Their base might be somewhere that reminds them of their creator.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: I've seen many similar cases in criminal psychology.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Somewhere in this city that resembles Moscow.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Moscow's cold, isn't it? It snows there in winter?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Snow?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: It hasn't snowed in Neo Kobe for years.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Then that's not it.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Wait. What about that pollen? Snow Cedar!

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: There was snow in Jamie's videophone call, too.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: That's it! Their hideout is somewhere along the Ina River.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: But the Ina River covers too much ground.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Let's put everything we've discussed on a map, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: This is an enlarged map of the Ina River area

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: in southwestern Neo Kobe City.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: The blue areas show where Snow Cedar grows.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Now I'll overlay the Tube Liner routes.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: I'll isolate the areas where the routes and cedars overlap.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: It's still too big. All that ground in twelve hours?

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Don't give up, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: If it reminds them of home,

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: perhaps the geography is similar, too.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: The same terrain would give them the same view.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: I'll display a map of Moscow beside it.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Huh? Look at that!

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Look! The rivers have the same shape!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: This one is the Moskva River.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Looks like our theory was right.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Metal, show us where Jamie and I were rescued.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Understood.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Here.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Metal, what was here before the Catastrophe?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: The Kremlin. The nerve center of the Soviet Union.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: The Kremlin?

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: The Snatcher said he was taking Jamie to the Kremlin!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Metal, what part of this city corresponds to the Kremlin?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Understood.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Found it. An old church.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: A huge, empty church. It's been in ruins for twenty years.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Right where the Snow Cedars and subway routes overlap!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: That's it! Their main base. A second Kremlin!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Let's hurry, Gillian!

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Wait, Gillian!

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: I'm coming, too!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: No!

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: I'm a JUNKER, too!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I know! And a good one!

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Then let me!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Guard the delegates at the summit. I doubt the Snatchers have given up.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: The summit's in Kyoto! I can't just run away!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Convince them not to drop a nuclear bomb on the city!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: We've found their hideout! No need to sink the whole island!

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: But...

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: It won't be easy. Can you do it?

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: All right, Gillian. I'll find a way.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Thank you, Mika.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Don't say that.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Come on. Let's go!

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Gillian!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: What?

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Well...

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: What is it?

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: How about dinner sometime?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Dinner?

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Yes. Dinner!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Mika...

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Why not? We can dress up. It's Christmas!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Christmas. I'll be back by then.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Let's hurry, Gillian!

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Promise me! It's a date!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: All right! I'll go ahead and say a prayer.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: See you soon, Gillian!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Let's go, Metal.
